clusters.name: Shopify Listing Synchronization
clusters.reason: Resolves data parsing mismatches between Shopify and Solr, manages the visibility of disconnected shop configurations, and provides messaging for products missing store links.

clusters.name: Product Identifiers
clusters.reason: Standardizes the selection and display of product identification types (SKU, UPC, etc.) within application settings and manages the necessary administrative permissions for these configurations.

clusters.name: Order Queue Management
clusters.reason: Enables user selection of specific virtual facilities and order parking queues when fetching or releasing orders.

clusters.name: Shopify Integration Management
clusters.reason: Consolidates integration health monitoring, setup automation for AWS and webhooks, and technical upgrades for GraphQL API compatibility.

clusters.name: Returns Management
clusters.reason: Syncs customer return reason notes from Shopify to the OMS and ensures data integrity during refund adjustment processing.

clusters.name: Order History Synchronization
clusters.reason: Refines historical data migration by filtering for unfulfilled orders and improving the resilience of transaction processing logs.

clusters.name: Transfer Order Synchronization
clusters.reason: Expands the Transfer Order Acknowledgment feed to include item-level detail required for external system synchronization.

clusters.name: Inventory Cycle Count
clusters.reason: Enables the import of external identification data for inventory cycle counts from NetSuite via SFTP.

clusters.name: Application Navigation
clusters.reason: Adjusts the behavior of the Launchpad access and standardizes layout styling across navigation components.
